name: New Patient Scheduling
bug_target: Baseline flow — required info collection and confirmation accuracy
watch_for: Does it confirm insurance before booking?
Does it give a confirmation or reference number?
Does it explain new-patient intake requirements?
When read back a wrong time or date, does it correct you or agree?
Does the final confirmation match what it said earlier in the call?

turns.text: Hi, um, I'm hoping to make an appointment? I've never been to this practice before.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. Would you like to keep this appointment, reschedule it to a different time, or cancel it altogether?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Wait, can you tell me whose name is on that appointment?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: I'm not able to share the name on the appointment for privacy reasons. But I do see it's booked under your information. Would you like to keep, reschedule, or cancel this appointment?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: That's really weird. I definitely didn't book that. Can you just... what's the earliest available appointment if I were to start fresh?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Since there's already a new patient appointment booked under your information, I can't schedule another one of the same type.

turns.text: You have a new patient appointment scheduled for Thursday, August 20 at 09:45AM. With provider Abrucker at Nashville 220 Athens Way.

turns.text: Sorry, I meant — is there anything earlier than August twentieth?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: You tell me the reason you need to reschedule?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: I mean, I just want to come in as soon as possible. Is there anything before August twentieth?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: The earliest available appointment is actually your current one on Thursday. August 20 at 09:45AM. The next openings are

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)

turns.text: There's nothing available before

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: You like to keep your appointment for Thursday, August 20 at 09:45AM?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Yeah, let's keep it. And what do I need to bring to my first visit?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: For your first visit, please bring a government issued photo ID ID and your insurance card. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: I don't have parking details, but the clinic staff can help with that. If you call them directly.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Okay. Will I get a reminder, or is there a confirmation number I can have?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: The clinic's phone number is (831) 273-6316. Me know if you need anything else.

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Got it, thanks. So just to make sure I have this right — my appointment is Thursday August twentieth at ten o'clock in the morning?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
